title: Argid as kionnaghey
description: Ten mini stories about money and shopping on the Isle of Man: a market, an antique shop, a charity shop, a used car, a party shop, a garden shop, saving wages, a dress for the opera, a shop in a hamlet and an independent bookshop.

lessons.title: Y margey ayns Rhumsaa
lessons.summary: Every Friday Hazel used to take the electric train from Laxey to the market in Ramsey; last Friday she takes her son Rowan, buys cabbage, potatoes and brown sugar for a simple sweet dish, feeds Rowan's hungry stomach, and a man carries her firewood to the stop.
lessons.text:
Dagh Jeheiney, va Hazel Keggin cliaghtey goll dys y margey ayns Rhumsaa. T'ee cummal ayns Laksaa, as ta stad beg y traen lectragh faggys da'n thie eck. Yn Jeheiney chaie, ghow ee e mac Rowan marish. Ta Rowan hoght bleeaney d'eash.

Roish my haink y traen, dooyrt Rowan, “Cre t'ou laccal y chionnaghey?”

“Caayl, praaseyn, shugyr as conney,” dooyrt Hazel. “Cha nel monney conney ain, as ta ny h-oieghyn feayr nish.”

Haink y traen dys y stad, as hie ad stiagh. Hass y traen ec stad elley ayns y glion, as haink ben shenn stiagh lesh moddey beg. Lurg lieh oor, v'ad ayns Rhumsaa.

Va'n margey lane dy leih. Va soar mie ayns yn aer: soar eeast, soar ooylyn as soar fuygh er aile. “S'mie lhiam yn soar shoh,” dooyrt Rowan.

Ec y chied boayrd, va eirinagh shenn creck caayl as praaseyn. “Cre'n leagh t'er y caayl?” dooyrt Hazel.

“Punt son dagh caayl,” dooyrt yn eirinagh. “As ta ny praaseyn tree punt.” Chionnee Hazel yn caayl as ny praaseyn.

Ec boayrd elley, va ben aeg creck shugyr bane as shugyr dhone. “Ta mee laccal shugyr dhone,” dooyrt Hazel. “Ta mee jannoo bee millish neuchramp: shugyr, oohyn, bainney as ooylyn. Ta shen ooilley.” Hug ee daa phunt son y shugyr.

Eisht dooyrt Rowan, “Ta my volg laccal bee!” Chionnee Hazel eeast as praaseyn çheh son y jees oc, as hoie ad sheese ec taabyl. Lurg shen, va bolg Rowan lane.

Ec y jerrey, hie ad dys y boayrd jerrinagh. Va dooinney mooar creck conney ayn. Chionnee Hazel conney son yn aile, agh va'n conney trome, as cha row ee abyl eh y ymmyrkey. Ren y dooinney y conney y ymmyrkey dys y stad er e son.

“Ta treisht aym dy bee yn conney shoh liooar son y geurey,” dooyrt Hazel.

“Ta treisht aym nagh bee'n traen anmagh,” dooyrt Rowan. Cha row eh anmagh.

Er y traen, dooyrt Rowan, “Ren shin ceau ram argid?”

“Cha ren,” dooyrt Hazel. “Hug mee nuy punt ooilley. She margey mie eh, as ta'n bee millish neuchramp.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n laa va Hazel cliaghtey goll dys y margey?
Va Hazel cliaghtey goll dys y margey dagh Jeheiney.
Quoi ghow Hazel marish yn Jeheiney chaie?
Ghow ee e mac Rowan marish.
Cre'n leagh va er y caayl?
Va'n caayl punt.
Cre'n fa va Hazel laccal shugyr dhone?
Va Hazel laccal shugyr son bee millish neuchramp.
Quoi ren y conney y ymmyrkey dys y stad?
Ren y dooinney mooar y conney y ymmyrkey dys y stad.

lessons.title: Y feeal Rooshish
lessons.summary: In a small antique shop in Douglas, chess master Gilbert finds an old chess set with Russian writing on it: Maureen tells him it belonged to an officer of the imperial army who was killed in the war before the communists took power, and after some haggling Gilbert buys it.
lessons.text:
Ta shapp beg ayns straid ghiare ayns Doolish, as t'eh creck shenn stoo. She Maureen Mylvane ben y shapp. Ta'n shapp lane dy lioaryn shenn, jallooyn, cappanyn as eaddagh. Er y voalley, ta gunn cahnagh shenn.

Laa dy row, haink Gilbert Casement stiagh 'sy shapp. Ta Gilbert cloie feeal, as she mainshtyr feeal eh. V'eh cliaghtey cloie feeal dagh oie Jeheiney 'sy chlub ayns Doolish, as t'eh kinjagh shirrey feeal shenn.

Honnick Gilbert boayrd feeal er taabyl beg. Va ny peeshyn jeant ass fuygh dhone as fuygh bane, as va screeuyn ayns Rooshish er y voayrd. “Cha nel mee lhaih Rooshish,” dooyrt Gilbert. “Cre ta'n screeu shoh gra?”

“Ta ennym offishear ayn,” dooyrt Maureen. “V'eh ny offishear ayns yn arm impiroil, roish my ghow ny cummynee y reiltys. Va'n offishear shoh ny vainshtyr feeal, as v'eh cliaghtey cloie marish ny h-offishearyn elley.”

“Cre haghyr da?” dooyrt Gilbert.

“Va'n offishear marrooit 'sy chaggey,” dooyrt Maureen. “Va'n reiltys cummynagh noi ny offishearyn impiroil, as va ram jeu marrooit. Va'n feeal currit da e inneen, as haink ee dys Sostyn. Ny s'anmey, va'n feeal kionnit ec ben ayns Ellan Vannin, as chreck ee eh dou.”

Eisht honnick Gilbert y gunn er y voalley. “As y gunn shen? Row eh ec yn offishear cheddin?”

“Cha row,” dooyrt Maureen. “Va'n gunn shoh ec sidoor ayns Ellan Vannin. She gunn cahnagh eh, agh cha nel eh obbraghey nish.”

“Cre'n leagh t'er y feeal?” dooyrt Gilbert.

“Keead as jeih punt,” dooyrt Maureen.

“Ta shen ro vooar,” dooyrt Gilbert. “Kiare feed punt?”

Va resoonaght eddyr Gilbert as Maureen son tammylt. Ec y jerrey, chionnee Gilbert y feeal son keead punt. “She resoonaght mie v'ayn,” dooyrt Maureen. “Ta fys ayd er leagh y stoo shenn.”

Ec y thie, hug Gilbert ny peeshyn er y voayrd. Ren eh cloie feeal marish e vac, as dinsh eh da mychione yn offishear Rooshish va ny vainshtyr feeal.

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Gilbert cliaghtey cloie?
T'eh cliaghtey cloie feeal, as she mainshtyr feeal eh.
Cre va er y voayrd feeal?
Va screeuyn ayns Rooshish er y voayrd.
Quoi va'n feeal echey?
Va'n feeal ec offishear ayns yn arm impiroil.
Cre haghyr da'n offishear?
Va'n offishear marrooit 'sy chaggey.
Row'n gunn ec yn offishear cheddin?
Cha row. Va'n gunn ec sidoor ayns Ellan Vannin.

lessons.title: Yn fainey airhey
lessons.summary: Yvonne is a volunteer in a charity shop in Port Erin; alone one day, she sees in the reflection on a black television screen a young man putting a gold ring in his pocket; the electronic tag rings the bell at the door, an officer comes, the young man gets a summons to court, and the judge, instead of prison, sends him to work in the shop.
lessons.text:
Ta Yvonne Garrod ny arryltagh ayns shapp ayns Purt Çhiarn. Ta'n shapp creck shenn eaddagh, lioaryn as cappanyn, as ta'n argid goll da paitçhyn ching. Ta queig arryltee 'sy shapp, as cha nel ad geddyn argid son yn obbyr. T'ad obbraghey son veg, er y fa dy vel graih oc er paitçhyn.

Laa dy row, va Yvonne ny lomarcan 'sy shapp. Haink guilley aeg stiagh. Ren eh jeeaghyn er ny lioaryn, as eisht hie eh dys y boayrd va ny fainaghyn er. Va çhellveeish shenn er y voayrd elley, as va scaan y ghuilley fakinagh 'sy çhellveeish. Honnick Yvonne y scaan. Ghow y guilley fainey airhey, as hug eh ayns e phoagey eh.

Va aggle er Yvonne. Cha row eaghtyrys eck dy ghreimmey yn guilley; cha nel eaghtyrys ec arryltagh. Agh va cowrey lectraneagh beg er y fainey. Tra hie y guilley magh, ren clag sheean ec y dorrys, er y fa dy row y cowrey lectraneagh ayns e phoagey.

Va aggle er y ghuilley neesht. Hass eh. Haink offishear veih'n stashoon, as ren eh loayrt rish y ghuilley. Va'n fainey fakinagh ayns laue y ghuilley nish. Hug y guilley y fainey da'n offishear. “Ta eaghtyrys aym,” dooyrt yn offishear, “as she shoh m'obbyr.”

Lurg shiaghtin, hooar y guilley symney. Va'n symney screeuit er pabyr: va'n guilley dy heet dys y chooyrt ayns Doolish. Hie Yvonne dys y chooyrt neesht. Ayns y chooyrt, dooyrt y briw dy row freggyrtys er y ghuilley son ny ren eh. “Ta mee goaill freggyrtys son shen,” dooyrt y guilley.

Cha row eh currit dys pryssoon, er y fa dy row eh aeg, as cha row eh ayns y chooyrt roie. “Cha nel pryssoon cooie son guilley aeg,” dooyrt y briw. Agh hug y briw er obbraghey 'sy shapp son jeih laa, myr arryltagh.

Ren eh obbraghey dy mie. Ec y jerrey, dooyrt eh rish Yvonne, “Ta mee toiggal nish dy vel freggyrtys orrin ooilley.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Yvonne jannoo 'sy shapp?
T'ee ny arryltagh 'sy shapp.
Cre'n aght honnick Yvonne y guilley?
Honnick ee scaan y ghuilley 'sy çhellveeish shenn.
Row eaghtyrys ec Yvonne dy ghreimmey yn guilley?
Cha row. Cha nel eaghtyrys ec arryltagh.
Cre hooar y guilley lurg shiaghtin?
Hooar eh symney dys y chooyrt.
Row'n guilley currit dys pryssoon?
Cha row. Ren eh obbraghey 'sy shapp myr arryltagh.

lessons.title: Yn carbyd noa
lessons.summary: Lionel's adopted son Kyle, seventeen, needs a car after his old one was destroyed in a storm: at a garage in Douglas they look at the wheels, Kyle drives on the left round a circular road and a small circuit, reverses carefully, Lionel complains that the hard seat hurts his bum, and Kyle buys the car with his own savings and his father's help.
lessons.text:
Ta Lionel Brennan cummal ayns Balley Chashtal marish e ven as Kyle. She doltey eh Kyle: haink eh dy chummal maroo tra v'eh tree bleeaney d'eash, as nish t'eh shiaght bleeaney jeig. Ta graih vooar ec Lionel er y doltey echey.

Va carbyd shenn ec Kyle, agh 'sy geurey chaie, huitt billey er y carbyd ayns geay lajer. Va'n carbyd stroit. “Ta mee laccal carbyd noa,” dooyrt Kyle. “Ta mee er hauail argid son blein.”

Jesarn, hie Lionel as Kyle dys Doolish, dys ynnyd va creck carbyd shenn. Honnick ad carbyd beg gorrym. “Ta kiare queeylyn noa er,” dooyrt y dooinney. “As cha nel eh stroit er aght erbee.” Ren Kyle jeeaghyn er dagh queeyl.

Ghow Kyle y carbyd magh er y raad. “Bee er y çheu clee,” dooyrt Lionel. “Ayns Ellan Vannin, ta shin goll er y çheu clee jeh'n raad.” Haink ad dys raad kiarkylagh mooar. Hie Kyle mygeayrt y raad kiarkylagh, as eisht hie ad mygeayrt çhymshal beg: veih Doolish dys Balley Chashtal as erash. Va'n çhymshal shoh mysh 30 kilometer.

Cha row Kyle goll rish leahys ro vooar. “Cre'n leahys smoo t'ec y carbyd?” dooyrt eh rish e ayr. “Cha nel shen scanshoil,” dooyrt Lionel. “Ta leahys beg share 'sy valley.”

Ec y jerrey, ren Kyle y carbyd y chur ergooyl eddyr daa charbyd elley. Hie eh ergooyl dy mie, as ren eh y carbyd y chur 'sy boayl cooie.

“Ta'n soiag shoh feer creoi,” dooyrt Lionel. “Ta thoin ching aym!”

Ren Kyle gearey. “Ta thoin ching ort, er y fa dy vel oo shenn,” dooyrt eh.

Va'n leagh 3,000 punt. Va 2,500 punt ec Kyle, as hug Lionel yn argid elley da. “Gura mie ayd,” dooyrt Kyle. “Ver mee yn argid shen erash dhyt.”

Feyshtyn:
Quoi eh Kyle?
She doltey Lionel eh.
Cre haghyr da'n shenn charbyd?
Huitt billey er, as va'n carbyd stroit.
Cre'n çheu jeh'n raad ta shin goll er ayns Ellan Vannin?
Ta shin goll er y çheu clee jeh'n raad.
Cre cho mooar as va'n çhymshal?
Va'n çhymshal mysh 30 kilometer.
Cre dooyrt Lionel mychione y soiag?
Dooyrt eh dy row y soiag creoi, as dy row thoin ching echey.

lessons.title: Partee Elin
lessons.summary: Shirley buys things for her daughter Elin's sixth birthday party, which is based on Elin's favourite cartoon about a girl travelling through space: the shopkeeper fills balloons with helium, explains that the air is mostly nitrogen, ties a string to each, sells bubble liquid, and at the party the children have a hunt for sweets before Elin opens her presents.
lessons.text:
Bee Elin Talbot shey bleeaney d'eash Jeheiney. Ta graih ec Elin er cartoon er y çhellveeish. Ta'n cartoon mychione inneen veg ta goll trooid y feaynid ayns lhong-speyr. T'ee goll veih planaid dys planaid, as t'ee fakin y tuinney ooilley: rollageyn, planaidyn as eayst ny planaid elley. She skeeal fansee eh, agh s'mie lesh Elin eh. Ta'n cartoon er y çhellveeish dagh laa.

Ta Shirley, moir Elin, laccal partee son e inneen, as ta'n partee dy ve mychione y cartoon. Hie ee dys shapp ny partee ayns Doolish.

“Ta mee laccal bolganyn,” dooyrt Shirley. “Bolganyn gorrym, myr y feaynid.” Ren ben y shapp ny bolganyn y lhieeney lesh hailium. “Cre'n fa ta ny bolganyn goll seose?” dooyrt Shirley.

“Er y fa nagh vel hailium cho trome as yn aer,” dooyrt y ven. “Ta'n aer jeant jeh neetragien er y chooid smoo, as jeh ocsygien. Ta neetragien ny s'trimmey na hailium. Myr shen, ta'n bolgan lesh hailium goll seose.”

Hug y ven tead er dagh bolgan. “Gow y tead ayns dty laue,” dooyrt ee, “er nagh jed y bolgan ersooyl 'sy speyr.” Chionnee Shirley fliughane neesht, son bolganyn beggey y yannoo. “Ta'n fliughane shoh mie son paitçhyn,” dooyrt y ven. “S'mie lesh paitçhyn ooilley eh.”

Jeheiney, haink kiare paitçhyn jeig dys y thie. Va coamrey fansee er dagh paitçhey, myr sleih veih'n tuinney. Ren ad bolganyn y yannoo lesh y fliughane 'sy garey. Eisht va shelg ayn. Va Shirley er follaghey bee millish ayns ynnydyn follit 'sy garey, as ren ny paitçhyn shelg er y son. Ren Elin y shelg y chosney.

Ec y jerrey, ren Elin ny giootyn eck y foshley. Ren ee gioot jerrinagh y foshley: va lioar ayn mychione y feaynid as y tuinney. “S'mie lhiam eh!” dooyrt Elin.

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta'n cartoon mychione?
T'eh mychione inneen veg ta goll trooid y feaynid.
Cre'n fa ta ny bolganyn goll seose?
Er y fa nagh vel hailium cho trome as yn aer.
Cre jeh ta'n aer jeant?
Ta'n aer jeant jeh neetragien er y chooid smoo, as jeh ocsygien.
Cre'n fa hug y ven tead er dagh bolgan?
Er nagh jed y bolgan ersooyl 'sy speyr.
Quoi ren y shelg y chosney?
Ren Elin y shelg y chosney.

lessons.title: Garey Cecil
lessons.summary: Retired Cecil wants a new lawn and a raised bed: at the garden shop the young man analyses his soil, sells him grass seed and a herb good for healing, explains the timber in centimetres to a man used to imperial measures, and with his granddaughter Hattie he prepares the ground around the old mound at the bottom of the garden while she counts the stamens of a lily.
lessons.text:
Ta Cecil Pickard cummal ayns Doolish. Ta garey mooar ec Cecil, agh va'n faiyr echey feer drogh: va'n faiyr buigh, as va onnaneyn ayns dagh boayl. Ta tomman beg ec bun y garey, as va onnaneyn er y tomman neesht. Ta Cecil laccal faiyr noa as kishtey mooar son lossreeyn.

Jesarn, hie eh dys shapp y garey marish inneen e inneen, Hattie. Dinsh eh da dooinney aeg 'sy shapp mychione y faiyr as ny onnaneyn.

“Roish my chur oo rass faiyr 'sy thalloo,” dooyrt y dooinney aeg, “ta'n ooir laccal aarlaghey. Ta oltscarr ooir ain 'sy shapp. Cur lhiat ooir veih'n garey, as nee'm oltscarr urree.”

Ren Cecil shen. Lurg yn oltscarr, dooyrt y dooinney aeg, “Ta'n ooir ayd laccal neetragien. Ta'n onnane mie lesh ooir drogh, agh cha nel y faiyr.” Chionnee Cecil rass faiyr as neetragien son yn ooir.

Eisht chionnee eh aamaid son y kishtey. “Ta dagh peesh aamaid kiare feed kentimeadar er lhiurid,” dooyrt y dooinney aeg. Ren Cecil gearey. “Ta mee shenn,” dooyrt eh. “Va mee kinjagh cliaghtey towshanyn impiroil. Cha nel kentimeadar aym!” Ren Hattie ginsh da: “Ta kiare feed kentimeadar mysh three trieyn.” Chionnee eh kiare peeshyn aamaid.

Va lossreeyn beggey creck 'sy shapp. “Ta'n lus shoh mie son lheihys,” dooyrt y dooinney aeg. “Ta lheihys ayns ny duillagyn echey: my ta dty chrackan ching, cur duillag er.” Chionnee Cecil eh.

Va blaa mooar bane er y taabyl. Ren Hattie jeeaghyn er yn staim ayns y blaa. “Ta shey staimyn ayn,” dooyrt ee, “as ta dagh staim buigh.”

Ec y thie, ren Cecil as Hattie yn thalloo y aarlaghey. Ghow ad ersooyl ny onnaneyn, as hug ad y rass faiyr 'syn ooir. Ren ad y kishtey y hroggal lesh yn aamaid. Cha ren ad bentyn rish y tomman. “She tomman shenn eh,” dooyrt Cecil. “Foddee dy vel eh ny oaie veih shenn traa.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n aght va'n faiyr ec Cecil?
Va'n faiyr buigh, as va onnaneyn ayns dagh boayl.
Cre ren y dooinney aeg lesh yn ooir?
Ren eh oltscarr er yn ooir.
Cre cho liauyr as va dagh peesh aamaid?
Va dagh peesh kiare feed kentimeadar er lhiurid.
Cre'n fa chionnee Cecil y lus beg?
Er y fa dy vel eh mie son lheihys.
Cre'n earroo dy staimyn va 'sy blaa?
Va shey staimyn 'sy blaa.

lessons.title: Sauail son y turrys
lessons.summary: Carys earns small wages in a Douglas café and carries golf bags on Sundays; she has a plan to save for a continental trip, moves money to a savings account every month, studies French grammar, including the active voice, because she longs to be fluent, and at the end of the summer she enjoys a boat trip on a French river.
lessons.text:
Ta Carys Dunn obbraghey ayns thie-bee ayns Doolish. Cha nel y faill eck mooar, agh t'ee sauail argid dagh shiaghtin. Ta plan eck: turrys mooarheeragh 'sy tourey. Ta foddeeaght urree son çheeraghyn elley. T'ee laccal fakin ny sleityn, ny ellanyn as ny caayryn mooarheeragh shenn.

Ta plan eck son yn argid neesht. Dagh mee, ta Carys garraghey lieh jeh'n faill eck veih'n coontey cadjin eck dys coontey sauail ec y vanc. “Ta soylley mooar ayns sauail,” dooyrt e moir. “Ta'n banc cur argid beg dhyt son yn argid ayns y choontey.”

Jedoonee, ta Carys obbraghey neesht ec y club golf. T'ee ymmyrkey stoo golf son ny cloiederyn. Cha nel faill eck ayns shen, agh ta ny cloiederyn golf cur argid jee. Ta paart jeu cur punt, as ta paart cur queig punt.

Ec yn oie, ta Carys ynsaghey Frangish. Ta foddeeaght urree dy ve flaaoil ayns Frangish. Ta lioar grammeydys eck, as t'ee lhaih mychione yn fwee jantagh. “Ayns yn fwee jantagh, ta'n fer ta jannoo y red ec toshiaght y raa,” dooyrt yn ynseyder eck. Ta fwee elley ayn neesht, agh cha nel Carys toiggal eh foast.

Ec jerrey yn tourey, va argid liooar eck. Hie ee er y lhong veih Doolish dys Lerphoyll, as eisht er y traen. Ren ee garraghey veih çheer dys çheer, as ren ee loayrt Frangish 'sy Rank. Cha row ee flaaoil, agh va sleih toiggal ee.

Ayns balley mooar, ghow ee shiaulley er yn awin. Va'n shiaulley daa oor, as ghow ee soylley mooar jeh. “Va'n plan aym mie,” dooyrt ee rish hene.

Feyshtyn:
Vel faill vooar ec Carys?
Cha nel. Cha nel y faill eck mooar.
Cre ta Carys jannoo dagh mee?
T'ee garraghey lieh jeh'n faill eck dys coontey sauail.
Cre ta Carys jannoo ec y club golf?
T'ee ymmyrkey stoo golf son ny cloiederyn.
Vel Carys flaaoil ayns Frangish?
Cha nel, agh va sleih toiggal ee.
Cre ghow Carys er yn awin?
Ghow ee shiaulley er yn awin.

lessons.title: Coamrey son y kiaulldramey
lessons.summary: Olwen's brother Tristan, a music critic, gets tickets for a new opera in Douglas; Olwen buys a dress whose bodice is too tight at first, studies her appearance, chooses a typical 1920s dress in an unusual colour, and at the opera, made from old Manx poetry, a flute plays and the singer sings well despite a sore throat; Tristan's review is kind.
lessons.text:
She cremeyder eh Tristan Blake. T'eh screeu mychione kiaull son pabyr-naight ayns Doolish. Hooar eh daa hoiag son kiaulldramey noa 'sy theater, as dooyrt eh rish e huyr Olwen, “Tar marish! Ta'n kiaulldramey shoh noa, as she oie vooar eh.”

Cha row coamrey mie ec Olwen son kiaulldramey. Hie ee dys shapp eaddagh. Ghow ee coamrey jiarg, agh va'n bouin ro veg. “Ta'n bouin shoh ro veg,” dooyrt ee. “Cha nel mee abyl ennal!”

Ren ben y shapp coamrey elley y chur jee. Ren Olwen jeeaghyn er y tuarystal eck 'sy scaan. “Cre'n tuarystal t'orrym?” dooyrt ee.

“She coamrey cowreydagh jeh ny bleeantyn 1920 eh,” dooyrt y ven. “Ta'n bouin lhean, as ta'n coamrey liauyr. As ta'n daah neuchadjin: gorrym as airhey.” S'mie lesh Olwen y daah neuchadjin. Va'n tuarystal eck feer vie. Chionnee ee yn coamrey son keead punt.

Jeheiney, hie Olwen as Tristan dys y theater. Va'n kiaulldramey jeant ass feeleeaght shenn ayns Gaelg. Va'n feeleeaght mychione ben veg as e graih er eeasteyr. Ec y toshiaght, ren feddan cloie lomarcan. Va sheean y feddan millish.

Va'n arraneyder ching: va farang ching echey. “Ta'n farang echey ching,” dooyrt Tristan. “Ta mee clashtyn eh.” Agh ghow eh ny arraneyn dy mie, as va'n sleih feer vooar jeh.

Lurg y kiaulldramey, ren y cremeyder screeu mychione. Dooyrt eh dy row y feeleeaght aalin, as dy row'n feddan mie neesht. Va'n cremeyder mie da'n arraneyder. “Va farang ching echey,” dooyrt Tristan, “as cha nel mee laccal screeu red drogh.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Tristan Blake?
She cremeyder eh. T'eh screeu mychione kiaull.
Cre'n fa nagh ghow Olwen y coamrey jiarg?
Er y fa dy row'n bouin ro veg.
Cre'n daah va er y coamrey cowreydagh?
Va'n daah neuchadjin: gorrym as airhey.
Cre ass va'n kiaulldramey jeant?
V'eh jeant ass feeleeaght shenn ayns Gaelg.
Cre va ching ec yn arraneyder?
Va farang ching echey.

lessons.title: Shapp ayns y claghan
lessons.summary: Mervyn runs a small shop in a hamlet near Peel that depends on tourism: he sells postcards of the view and maps of the six sheadings, sends French visitors to the old chapel, a sacred place with a carved stone pillar in the graveyard where a Viking is buried, and the public toilets the council built attract more tourists.
lessons.text:
Ta Mervyn Royle cummal ayns claghan beg faggys da Pheeil. Cha nel agh nuy thieyn 'sy claghan, as un shapp: shapp Mervyn. Ta'n shapp creck bee, pabyryn-naight, as reddyn son keayrtee. Ta turrysid scanshoil da'n claghan. 'Sy tourey, ta ram keayrtee çheet, as t'ad kionnaghey ram. 'Sy geurey, cha nel monney turrysid ayn.

Ta jallooyn 'sy shapp lesh reayrtys mie jeh'n traie as jeh ny sleityn. Ta kaartyn ayn neesht jeh ny shey sheadinyn. Ta Ellan Vannin rheynnit ayns shey sheadinyn, as ta Pheeil ayns sheadin Glenfaba.

Laa dy row, haink daa cheayrtagh veih Paarys stiagh, Margot as Luc. Chionnee ad kaart jeh'n sheadin as jalloo lesh reayrtys jeh'n traie. “Cre ta ry-akin ayns shoh?” dooyrt Luc.

“Ta keeill shenn ec kione y claghan,” dooyrt Mervyn. “She ynnyd casherick eh. Ta ruillick shenn mygeayrt-y-mysh. Ta ree shenn oanluckit 'sy ruillick, as ta colloo cloaie er y voayl, lesh crosh er.”

“Quoi t'oanluckit fo'n cholloo?” dooyrt Margot.

“Cha nel fys ain er yn ennym echey,” dooyrt Mervyn. “Agh ta'n colloo mysh thousane blein d'eash.”

Hie Margot as Luc dys y ruillick. Haink ad erash lurg oor, as chionnee ad bee as jough. “Va'n reayrtys veih'n ynnyd casherick aalin,” dooyrt Margot.

'Sy vlein chaie, ren y coonseil raad pobbylagh noa y hroggal dys y keeill, as pairk pobbylagh veg 'sy claghan. “Ta'n turrysid ny share nish,” dooyrt Mervyn. “Ta'n raad pobbylagh cleayn keayrtee. As ta'n ruillick as y colloo cleayn ad neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n fa ta turrysid scanshoil da'n claghan?
Er y fa dy vel keayrtee kionnaghey ram 'sy tourey.
Vel shey sheadinyn ayns Ellan Vannin?
Ta. Ta shey sheadinyn ayns Ellan Vannin.
Cre ta ec kione y claghan?
Ta keeill shenn ayn. She ynnyd casherick eh.
Quoi t'oanluckit 'sy ruillick?
Ta ree shenn oanluckit 'sy ruillick.
Cre ta cleayn keayrtee nish?
Ta'n raad pobbylagh noa as y ruillick cleayn keayrtee.

lessons.title: Y shapp lioaryn neuchrogheydagh
lessons.summary: Bethan owns an independent bookshop in Ramsey that her grandmother founded; when a powerful company plans a big shop on the edge of town, the independent shops, a minority in the town, form an allied group, and an influential councillor raises the matter with a parliamentary question in Tynwald.
lessons.text:
Ta shapp lioaryn neuchrogheydagh ec Bethan Lowe ayns Rhumsaa. She shapp neuchrogheydagh eh: cha nel eh ayrn jeh colught mooar. Ta shellooderys y shapp ec Bethan hene. Va'n shellooderys ec e moir roish, as roish shen ec moir e moir. She moir e moir va kiaddeyder y shapp, ayns 1950.

“Ta'n shapp shoh bunneydys my vea,” dooyrt Bethan. “Ren moir my moir y bunneydys y hroggal, as ta mee freayll eh.”

'Sy tourey, hooar Bethan naight drogh. Va colught niartal laccal shapp feer vooar y hroggal ec oirr y valley. “Ta'n colught shen feer niartal,” dooyrt Bethan. “Bee lioaryn oc er leagh ny sloo na ain.”

Ta ny shappyn neuchrogheydagh ayns Rhumsaa mynlagh nish. Ta'n chooid smoo jeh'n argid goll dys colughtyn mooarey. Agh ren ny shappyn mynlagh shoh possan cochaarjagh y yannoo. Va possan cochaarjagh jeh shey shappyn: shapp eeast, shapp feill, shapp blaaghyn, as shappyn elley.

Hie y possan dys coonseilagh y valley, Desmond Price. She coonseilagh cummaghtagh eh: t'eh er ve 'sy choonseil son feed blein, as ta sleih goaill tastey jeh. “Nee'm loayrt er nyn son,” dooyrt y coonseilagh.

Ren Desmond loayrt rish oltey jeh Tinvaal. Ghow yn oltey shen y chooish dys Tinvaal, as hug eh feyshtyn parlamaidagh. Va'n feyshtyn parlamaidagh shoh: “Vel y reiltys cur kiarail da shappyn neuchrogheydagh?”

Lurg y feyshtyn parlamaidagh, va'n colught niartal ny sloo shickyr. Cha ren ad y shapp mooar y hroggal foast. Ren Bethan gearey. “Ta coonseilagh cummaghtagh feeu ram,” dooyrt ee.

Feyshtyn:
Quoi va kiaddeyder y shapp?
She moir moir Bethan va kiaddeyder y shapp.
Quoi ec ta shellooderys y shapp nish?
Ta shellooderys y shapp ec Bethan hene.
Cre va'n colught niartal laccal y yannoo?
Va'n colught laccal shapp feer vooar y hroggal ec oirr y valley.
Cre ren ny shappyn mynlagh?
Ren ad possan cochaarjagh y yannoo.
Cre ren yn oltey jeh Tinvaal?
Hug eh feyshtyn parlamaidagh.
